O(n + mlogk)


Worst:

O(m + k)

Frequency range = 1...n

Time:

O(n)

O(n)

No sorting.

No heap operations.

Linear traversal only.

Because of JavaScript's lexical scoping, an inner function can access variables from its outer function.
